# Read points

## When to use this

when somebody pastes titles with their points lines

## What a good result looks like

Each title with its points, in the order given, and the total.

## When it comes back empty

A list with no points line is refused in fixed words.

## How to do it

1. node scripts/read.mjs --job <job folder> --records <records folder>
